notes: I read the four supplied source files to check claims. All trial-derived numbers are correct, and I checked the power, posterior and sample-size figures by hand. The main departure from the reference: the output recommends a shrunk base case of +2 pp (about 5% relative) instead of the reference's 3.2 pp (7.8%). It uses 3.2 pp as the upside and labels the shrinkage prior as its own assumption. I did not penalise this as an error, but a human may weigh it differently under usefulness or accuracy. It does not say 'ship the flow' outright, although keeping a holdout on the old flow implies it. I could not verify the four external citations (arXiv IDs, a Google Doc and a 2026 blog post), and the output admits they were seen only through search summaries; this is part of why accuracy is 0.75. Minor misattribution: the pricing-change note sits in the A/B readout section, but in the sources it appears only in support-ticket-trend.md.
